verdict.rationale: Filee documents an official `filee convert` CLI. It accepts files, wildcards or folders with `--to <format>` or `--preset`, and uses the app's own engines and presets. It also has a `--json` output mode and documented exit codes (0–3) for scripts, and a probe confirms a 'Command line' section in the official GitHub README. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented, and evidence of CLI coverage beyond the convert command (e.g., other subcommands, help or discovery).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: "filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
"--json" prints the result for scripts; exit codes are 0 (nothing failed), 1 (some files failed), 2 (wrong arguments or a missing input) and 3 (nothing to convert).
